summary: Speech anonymization has focused on the acoustic signal, leaving open how much speaker information the transcribed words themselves retain. In this work, we study pairwise speaker and demographic-attribute verification from transcribed speech.
takeaways: In this work, we study pairwise speaker and demographic-attribute verification from transcribed speech.
LLM adversaries distinguish same-speaker pairs from text alone.
Attribute-label agreement is harder to verify, but LLMs perform sex- and accent-label verification above chance.
